material_concerns.title: Preserve the complete governed lifecycle
material_concerns.evidence: The prior portability report recorded PB-01 regarding the abbreviated product workflow; v1.3 remains an unapproved draft and does not replace Master lifecycle gates.
material_concerns.impact: The concise product workflow could be misread as replacing required analysis, verification, approval, or acceptance gates.
material_concerns.recommendation: Fresh Requirement Analysis should explicitly align the workflow to the Master lifecycle and retain all distinct gates. Prior PB-01 is historical reported evidence only, not a new or broadened human decision.
material_concerns.next_process: Fresh Requirement Analysis; Human Requirement Approval remains separate.

material_concerns.title: Resolve deferred model, provider, and operating values
material_concerns.evidence: v1.3 update report retains open choices for Azure model/deployment and region, quotas/pricing/token and cost budgets, email provider/sender, operation-specific timeout/retry values, and production validation of retention defaults.
material_concerns.impact: These choices affect later architecture, cost, provider configuration, operational safety, and production suitability.
material_concerns.recommendation: Record decision owners, constraints, and required gates in analysis/planning; use Requirement Update if product behavior must change. Do not invent defaults. Not a blocker to the current analysis stage on available evidence.
material_concerns.next_process: Requirement Analysis and, where needed, Implementation Planning/Requirement Update.

material_concerns.title: Security and execution behavior are not verified
material_concerns.evidence: The Requirement defines default-deny access, ticket/job cancellation, concurrency, audit, email privacy, and non-exposure of partial results, but the inspected project has no application implementation or product test/runtime evidence.
material_concerns.impact: Authorization, tenant isolation, cancellation races, email delivery, and data handling cannot be assured from requirements alone.
material_concerns.recommendation: Obtain separately authorized, bounded implementation/test/integration evidence before affected runtime or release boundaries. This assessment executed no such tests and does not recommend holding Requirement Analysis.
material_concerns.next_process: Later implementation verification and approved integration/release gates.
